conditions.zh-CN: 正文要求先与客户确认设计方向；在无人值守的 AI 同事任务中无法询问时，写明所作假设后继续
conditions.en: The skill asks you to confirm the design direction with the client first; in unattended AI teammate tasks where you cannot ask, state your assumptions and continue

conditions.zh-CN: 正文鼓励使用非默认字体：优先使用系统字体栈或自托管字体，引用外部字体须经用户同意
conditions.en: The skill encourages non-default fonts: prefer system font stacks or self-hosted fonts, and load external fonts only with the user's consent

conditions.zh-CN: 正文以 Claude 界面主色 #D97757 作为避免默认配色的校准示例，在 Teloa 中同样适用，无需调整
conditions.en: The skill uses Claude's interface accent #D97757 as a calibration example of a default palette to avoid; it applies equally in Teloa and needs no change
